scenes.heading: Introduction
scenes.narration: Components. Introduction. In this video we review 7 key concepts you need to know for the certification.

scenes.question: What do templates define before this lesson turns to the components themselves?

scenes.body: The speech opens by saying that templates define where components can go, and the lesson then shifts to the internal structure and implementation of the components themselves.
